intro.en: Transmission harnesses carry power, commands and feedback between a transmission control unit, mechatronic assembly, solenoids, speed or position sensors, range selector and the vehicle-side loom. The category includes external gearbox leads, sealed through-case interfaces and, where specified, oil-wet internal branches. The correct assembly depends on the exact transmission and vehicle variant, not a generic gearbox plug.
intro.zh: 变速箱线束在变速箱控制单元、机电液模块、电磁阀、转速或位置传感器、挡位选择器与整车线束之间传输电源、指令和反馈。本小类包括箱体外部引线、穿壳密封接口，以及按项目要求制作的油浸式内部支路。正确的组件取决于准确的变速箱和车型变型，不能按所谓通用变速箱插头确定。

knowledge.en: A transmission controller interprets sensor signals and drives the relevant actuators; it may be integrated into a module, attached to the transmission or housed separately. A harness therefore needs a controlled pin map and an explicit boundary between oil-wet, through-wall and vehicle-side environments. Matching connector shape alone does not establish signal identity, fluid compatibility or leak tightness.
knowledge.zh: 变速箱控制单元读取传感器信号并驱动相应执行器；它可能集成在模块中、安装于变速箱上，也可能独立布置。因此线束必须有受控针脚表，并明确油浸区、穿壳区和整车外侧环境的边界。接头外形相同不能证明信号身份、油液相容性或密封可靠性。

notes.en: For quotation, identify vehicle and transmission model, model year and variant, TCU or mechatronic reference, internal or external scope, connector part numbers and cavity views, solenoid and sensor assignments, operating voltage, route and clip datums, specified fluid and temperature exposure, drawings or an approved sample, quantities and the required inspection plan. Oil-wet or safety-related scope needs separate review.
notes.zh: 询价请提供车型、变速箱型号、年款与变型、TCU 或机电液模块料号、内部或外部供货范围、连接器料号与孔位视图、电磁阀和传感器回路、电压、走线与固定基准、指定油液和温度暴露、图纸或批准样品、数量及所需检验计划。油浸或安全相关范围须单独审核。

delivery.en: Approved inputs become a circuit matrix, connector BOM, branch drawing, material record and first-article inspection plan. Checks can include cavity and wire identity, terminal seating, locks, branch dimensions, connector mating and agreed electrical tests. Fluid resistance, seal integrity, controller behavior and vehicle shift performance require their own specified methods and acceptance criteria; continuity alone does not establish them.
delivery.zh: 批准资料转化为回路矩阵、连接器物料表、分支图、材料记录与首件检验计划。可核对孔位与线号、端子入位、锁止、分支尺寸、对插及约定电气项目。耐油、密封、控制器行为和整车换挡性能均需各自规定试验方法与接收标准，不能由导通合格推导。

introduction.zh: 一个变速箱，三种电气环境

subtitle.en: External routes, through-case sealing and oil-wet circuits—defined as one controlled interface map
subtitle.zh: 箱体外部走线、穿壳密封与油浸回路，按同一受控接口图定义

lead.en: Follow the circuit from the vehicle loom to the gearbox housing and then, when the design calls for it, into the oil-wet mechatronic space. Each boundary changes the connector, material, installation and evidence needed for release.
lead.zh: 沿回路从整车线束走到变速箱壳体，再按具体设计进入油浸机电液区域。每穿过一个边界，连接器、材料、安装方法与放行证据都可能改变。

title.en: External lead, case interface or internal loom?
title.zh: 箱外引线、穿壳接口，还是箱内支路？

copy.en: A transmission harness may stop at a vehicle-side plug, continue through a housing feedthrough, or distribute circuits inside the case. A detached gearbox photograph shows external wiring, but it cannot identify the correct replacement branch for another unit. Define the exact transmission code, controller location, breakpoints and mating halves before treating an old sample as the master. Automatic, dual-clutch and automated-manual units can package the same functions differently. Mark what remains part of the OEM mechatronic module and what can be supplied as a separate harness; this avoids an apparently complete assembly with an unassigned interface.
copy.zh: 变速箱线束可以止于整车侧插头，也可以经过箱体穿通件，继续向内部回路分配。拆下的变速箱照片能看到箱外走线，却不能确定另一款变速箱该用哪条替换支路。必须先明确变速箱代码、控制器位置、断开点和对插两侧，再决定旧样能否作为制作依据。液力自动、双离合与自动化手动变速箱可能用不同方式集成相似功能。应标明哪些属于原厂机电液模块，哪些可作为独立线束供货，避免组件表面完整却留下未定义接口。

copy.en: Record vehicle-side, housing and internal module connectors separately.
copy.zh: 分别记录整车侧、箱体侧和内部模块接口。

copy.en: A gearbox family name alone is not a pin map.
copy.zh: 变速箱家族名称不能代替针脚表。

title.en: From TCU command to solenoid actuation
title.zh: 从 TCU 指令到电磁阀执行

copy.en: The transmission control unit evaluates sensor information and commands electrohydraulic or electromechanical actuators. On some designs the controller and valve-body mechatronics are integrated; on others the controller is attached to the gearbox or located elsewhere. That architecture decides whether a branch carries a low-level sensor signal, a supply and ground, an actuator drive or a communication line. The pictured mechatronic unit illustrates several closely packed solenoids and electrical paths; its pin allocation is not universal. For a new assembly, map each load and return path to the approved module data, account for simultaneous current and heat, and specify any required shielding or pair geometry.
copy.zh: 变速箱控制单元依据传感器信息，驱动电液或机电执行器。有的设计把控制器与阀体机电液模块集成，有的把控制器装在箱体上或布置在别处。架构决定一条支路承载的是低电平传感信号、供电与回路、执行器驱动，还是通信线。照片中的机电液总成展示多个紧密排列的电磁阀与电气路径，但它的针脚分配并不通用。新组件应按批准的模块资料逐条映射负载及返回路径，核对并发电流和热负荷，并规定需要的屏蔽或线对结构。

copy.en: Do not size a sensor circuit as if it were a solenoid feed.
copy.zh: 不能把传感回路按电磁阀供电来定义。

copy.en: Electrical fit is not software or calibration compatibility.
copy.zh: 电气能接通，不等于软件或标定兼容。

title.en: Speed, position and pressure have different jobs
title.zh: 转速、位置与压力信号各司其职

copy.en: Depending on the transmission, input, output or intermediate speed sensors inform shift control; position sensing can report a selector, shift fork or parking state, while pressure sensing may reflect a hydraulic circuit. The photographed gear-change unit shows close mechanical and electrical packaging, not a specified sensor or approved replacement. Identify the actual device type, power or reference supply, return, output form and cavity view from the vehicle documentation. Sensor leads should be routed clear of sharp castings and moving linkages, with controlled retention and any platform-specified noise treatment. One misassigned cavity can produce a plausible continuity result and still send the wrong information to the TCU.
copy.zh: 按变速箱设计，输入、输出或中间轴转速传感器为换挡控制提供信息；位置传感可反馈选择器、拨叉或驻车状态，压力传感则可能反映液压回路。图中的换挡单元展示紧邻的机械与电气结构，不代表指定传感器或批准替换件。应依车辆资料确认准确器件类型、供电或参考电压、回路、输出形式与孔位视图。传感器引线要避开尖锐铸件与运动连杆，明确固定方式和平台要求的抗干扰措施。一个孔位错配即使导通表面正常，也可能向 TCU 发送错误信息。

copy.en: A sensor, switch and solenoid need different test assumptions.
copy.zh: 传感器、开关、电磁阀的检测前提不同。

copy.en: Set clearance to the real linkage and service path.
copy.zh: 按实际连杆与维修路径确定间隙。

title.en: Internal branches live with the fluid
title.zh: 箱内支路与油液共同工作

copy.en: Inside an automatic transmission, a short lead, flat circuit or connector may sit beside a valve body under the oil pan. The open-housing photograph makes that environment visible. Wire insulation, contact finish, seals, overmold or carrier material must be assessed against the specified transmission fluid, additives, temperature and duration; appearance or a generic 'oil-resistant' label is not evidence. The route must avoid pinch points during pan or module installation and keep particles or loose strands out of the hydraulic system. If the component is to be supplied for oil immersion, cleanliness, material compatibility and the exact acceptance tests belong in the controlled drawing rather than in a general catalog promise.
copy.zh: 自动变速箱内部，短引线、扁平电路或接头可能位于阀体旁、油底壳之下。打开箱体的照片让这一环境一目了然。导线绝缘、触点镀层、密封、包覆与支架材料都应针对指定变速箱油、添加剂、温度和接触时长评估；外观或笼统的“耐油”字样不是证据。布线路径必须避开油底壳或模块安装时的夹伤点，同时避免颗粒和散丝进入液压系统。若供货件需要浸油，洁净度、材料相容性与准确的接收试验都应写进受控图纸，不能用一般目录承诺替代。

copy.en: Approval must cover the specified fluid and exposure, not oil in general.
copy.zh: 认可应覆盖指定油液与暴露条件，而非泛称的油。

copy.en: Define handling and particle limits when the project requires them.
copy.zh: 项目有要求时明确操作与颗粒限值。

title.en: A dry outside depends on the case boundary
title.zh: 箱外保持干燥，关键在穿壳边界

copy.en: The connector passing through a gearbox housing is a mechanical seal and an electrical interface at once. A case full of fluid, as pictured, makes a leak path consequential. A correctly shaped plug cannot compensate for the wrong guide sleeve, O-ring, insertion depth, lock position or damaged bore. ZF service information for one 6HP design explicitly treats the mechatronic guide sleeve, electrical plug and final leak check as separate steps; that is an example, not a procedure for every transmission. A project drawing should identify the OEM-approved feedthrough and seals, assembly direction, retention and required leak test. External splash sealing and internal fluid containment are different requirements.
copy.zh: 穿过变速箱壳体的接头同时是机械密封与电气接口。照片中的油液说明：一旦这里形成泄漏路径，后果不仅是插头接触不良。外形正确的插头也不能弥补错误的导向套、O 形圈、插入深度、锁止位置或受损孔壁。ZF 对某款 6HP 的维修资料把机电液导向套、电气插头和最终渗漏检查分成不同步骤；这只是实例，不是所有变速箱的通用装法。项目图纸应指定原厂批准的穿壳件与密封、装配方向、固定方式和所需泄漏试验。外侧防溅水与箱内油液密封是两种要求。

copy.en: Seal geometry belongs to the specified housing and feedthrough.
copy.zh: 密封几何由指定箱体和穿通件共同决定。

copy.en: Continuity and visual checks cannot replace an agreed leak test.
copy.zh: 导通与外观检查不能代替约定的渗漏试验。

title.zh: 挡位逻辑与首件证据要分清

copy.en: The cabin selector is one visible end of the system, but PRND markings do not reveal whether a vehicle uses a mechanical cable, switch contacts, a position sensor or shift-by-wire. Replacement pigtails and adapter leads must follow the exact platform circuit table; park, reverse and neutral-related signals can affect vehicle behavior and require OEM-defined safety review. Before cutting or crimping, reconcile both connector views, terminal and wire specifications, branch datums and the first-article test matrix. Check wire identity, terminal seating, locks, strain relief and fit on the approved mating parts. Electrical continuity confirms a mapped circuit, not shift quality, parking function, software state or roadworthiness; those need separately agreed system-level validation.
copy.zh: 座舱挡位选择器是系统可见的一端，但 PRND 标记并不能说明车辆采用机械拉索、开关触点、位置传感器还是线控换挡。替换尾线和转接线必须遵循准确的平台回路表；驻车、倒车和空挡相关信号可能影响车辆行为，需按整车方要求单独审核安全边界。下料和压接前，应核对两侧连接器视图、端子与线材规格、分支基准以及首件检验矩阵。检验线号、端子入位、锁止、应力缓解及批准对插件的配合。导通只能证明约定回路对应，不能证明换挡品质、驻车功能、软件状态或道路适用性；这些要另行开展系统级验证。

copy.en: The same cabin appearance can hide different electrical designs.
copy.zh: 座舱外观相似，也可能对应不同电气设计。

copy.en: Document what was inspected and what remains a vehicle-level test.
copy.zh: 记录已检项目，也写清仍需整车验证的项目。

q.en: Is an external transmission lead the same as an internal mechatronic harness?
q.zh: 箱外变速箱引线等同于箱内机电液线束吗？

a.en: No. They have different installation, fluid exposure, connector and cleanliness requirements. Define the breakpoints and whether a through-case interface belongs to the assembly.
a.zh: 不等同。安装位置、油液暴露、连接器和洁净度要求都可能不同。必须明确断开点，以及穿壳接口是否属于供货范围。

q.en: Can a matching gearbox plug prove interchangeability?
q.zh: 变速箱插头能对插就能互换吗？

a.en: No. Compare transmission and controller references, cavity view, circuit assignment, terminal system, sealing parts and software variant. A mating shell does not validate shifting behavior.
a.zh: 不能。还要比较变速箱与控制器料号、孔位视图、回路分配、端子体系、密封件与软件变型。能插上不等于换挡行为正确。

q.en: Does continuity testing prove the feedthrough will not leak?
q.zh: 导通测试能证明穿壳接口不漏油吗？

a.en: No. Continuity tests electrical mapping. Fluid containment needs the correct approved seals and installation, followed by the project-specific leak or pressure test.
a.zh: 不能。导通只检查电气映射。油液密封需要正确的批准密封件和安装，并按项目规定进行渗漏或压力试验。

q.en: Can an old transmission sample define the full new harness?
q.zh: 旧变速箱样品可以直接定义新线束吗？

a.en: A sample helps locate branches and connectors, but previous repairs, worn seals, hidden material grades and software variants can mislead. Cross-check it against current OEM drawings and approved mating parts before the first article.
a.zh: 样品可帮助定位分支与接头，但旧维修、密封磨损、隐藏材料牌号和软件变型都可能误导。首件前应与现行整车图纸及批准对插件交叉核对。

q.en: What should be included in a transmission-harness inquiry?
q.zh: 变速箱线束询价应提供哪些资料？

a.en: Send the vehicle and transmission code, TCU or mechatronic part number, internal/external scope, pin table and connector views, routes and fixation, specified fluid and temperature, sample or drawing, quantity and required tests.
a.zh: 请提供车型及变速箱代码、TCU 或机电液模块料号、箱内／箱外范围、针脚表与接口视图、走线和固定方式、指定油液与温度、样品或图纸、数量及所需试验。
